101._app: Wiki in CT 101 on pve1: Node app wiki.service on :3000, nginx :80 in front, SQLite at /var/lib/wiki/wiki.db. LAN only.

web.note: If the app crash-loops on a code, config or migration error, a restart won't help: no fix, quote the error. If nginx -t fails, no fix (config edits are a human job).

disk.note: Never delete application data. If the journal and apt cache are not the cause, report the biggest directories.

guest.note: NEVER start it: someone may have shut it down. Report only.
